scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run build:web
scripts.build:packages: bun run build:core && bun run build:sheet-engine && bun run build:xlsx-io
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:core && bun run build:core && bun run typecheck:sheet-engine && bun run build:sheet-engine && bun run typecheck:xlsx-io && bun run build:xlsx-io && bun run typecheck:web
scripts.test: bun run build:packages && bun run test:core && bun run test:sheet-engine && bun run test:xlsx-io && bun run test:web
scripts.lint: bun run lint:core && bun run lint:sheet-engine && bun run lint:xlsx-io && bun run lint:web && bun run lint:tools
scripts.lint:web: bun run --filter @sheetcraft/web lint && bun run check:web-ui
scripts.lint:tools: oxlint --deny-warnings scripts tools/compatibility-lab/src tools/compatibility-lab/scripts tools/compatibility-lab/tests tools/compatibility-lab/vitest.config.ts
scripts.verify:worker: bun run build:packages && bun scripts/verify-worker-bundle.mts && bun scripts/verify-xlsx-worker.mts
scripts.ci: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run check:boundaries && bun run check:compatibility && bun run verify:packages && bun run verify:worker && bun run check:bundle
